name: WordPress Manager
description: Independent WordPress workspace with Hostinger temporary-domain setup, safe imports, backups, transfers, update review and cache tools.
author: Zoer contributors

requiredConnections.purpose: Sign in to Hostinger accounts so WordPress Manager can list and manage their websites.

requiredEndpoints.purpose: Pull from and push to WordPress sites running Zoer Connect.

actions.title: Refresh WordPress sites
actions.description: Inspect DDEV WordPress sites and reconcile their credential-free MariaDB links into Zoer's database registry.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: List and inspect DDEV WordPress runtimes and register their linked database references.

actions.title: Start site
actions.description: Start one selected DDEV WordPress runtime.

actions.title: Stop site
actions.description: Stop one selected DDEV WordPress runtime without deleting its project.

actions.title: Create DDEV site
actions.description: Create a new local DDEV WordPress site owned by WordPress Manager.

actions.title: List trashed sites
actions.description: List DDEV WordPress sites in the Zoer trash with their scheduled purge dates.

actions.title: Move site to trash
actions.description: Stop one DDEV WordPress site and move it to the Zoer trash. It can be restored until its scheduled purge.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Move a DDEV WordPress site to the trash.

actions.title: Restore site from trash
actions.description: Restore one trashed DDEV WordPress site and start it.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Restore a trashed DDEV WordPress site.

actions.title: Plan removal from Zoer
actions.description: Describe what removing one trashed DDEV WordPress site from Zoer does and what stays on the DDEV host, with the confirmation phrase.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Plan the removal of a trashed DDEV WordPress site.

actions.title: Remove site from Zoer
actions.description: Remove one trashed DDEV WordPress site from Zoer after the reviewed plan and typed confirmation. The DDEV project directory and database files remain on the bridge host; it cannot be restored from the Zoer trash afterwards.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Remove a trashed DDEV WordPress site from Zoer.

actions.title: Check Zoer Connect site
actions.description: Read the Zoer Connect status of one added site through its saved endpoint key and check that it answers for that address, or (diagnostics) read its table, theme and plugin inventory for transfers.

actions.title: Check Hostinger account
actions.description: Check that one Hostinger account connected to WordPress Manager can list its websites.

actions.title: List database snapshots
actions.description: List DDEV database snapshots for a selected WordPress site.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Read snapshots for a DDEV site.

actions.title: Create database snapshot
actions.description: Create a named DDEV database-server snapshot before risky development changes.

actions.title: Restore database snapshot
actions.description: Replace the selected site's entire DDEV database server with a named snapshot. This intentionally requires Full access approval.

actions.title: Refresh plugin inventory
actions.description: List plugin status, versions, available updates, and auto-update state across running DDEV WordPress sites.

actions.title: Refresh theme inventory
actions.description: List theme status, versions, available updates, and auto-update state across running DDEV WordPress sites.

actions.title: Refresh user inventory
actions.description: List non-secret user identity, roles, and registration dates. Email, passwords, hashes, and sessions are excluded.

actions.title: Run Site Health
actions.description: Run bounded WordPress Site Health tests across running sites and return plain-text good, recommended, or critical results.

actions.title: Refresh application backups
actions.description: List integrity-manifested database and WP_CONTENT_DIR backups stored by the DDEV bridge.

actions.title: Create application backup
actions.description: Export the WordPress database and archive the resolved WP_CONTENT_DIR with an integrity manifest. Repository files remain protected by Git.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Create a database and WP_CONTENT_DIR backup.

actions.title: Restore application backup
actions.description: Verify the exact manifest and component digests, snapshot the current database, then replace the database and WP_CONTENT_DIR. Requires one-time Full access approval.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Restore an integrity-checked WordPress application backup.

actions.title: Run read-only WP-CLI
actions.description: Run an argv-based WP-CLI command from the bridge's explicit read-only allowlist.

actions.title: Pull site
actions.description: Export a Zoer Connect site and download it, verified, into a file set on this Zoer server. A dry run downloads into a scratch set and keeps nothing.

actions.title: Export local site
actions.description: Export a local DDEV WordPress site through the DDEV bridge into a verified file set, for pushing it to another site.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Export a local DDEV WordPress site into a file set.

actions.title: Compare with destination
actions.description: Compare a verified pull or local export with a destination Zoer Connect site, 20 paths per request, and save the classification for a selective push. Changes nothing on the destination.

actions.title: Push to site
actions.description: Push a verified pull or local export into a Zoer Connect site: create the remote import, upload verified blocks, then step the import through review and activation. A dry run builds and checks the import plan and sends nothing.

actions.title: Find & replace on site
actions.description: Run a reviewed find & replace on a Zoer Connect site: the site snapshots its own tables, stages the changes and waits for review before activating them. A dry run only checks the plan.

actions.title: Approve, finish, roll back or clean up an import
actions.description: Act on an import on a Zoer Connect site: approve it after review, finish it after verification, roll it back, or remove its staged files after it ended.

actions.title: Make a local copy
actions.description: Pull a Zoer Connect site (or use a verified pull) and restore it into a new or refreshed local DDEV site: staged verified files, the reviewed import scripts, its own address, plugins inactive. A dry run restores into a scratch site that is moved to the trash afterwards.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Create or refresh a local DDEV copy and restore the verified files into it.

actions.title: Restore WordPress backup locally
actions.description: Restore a verified UpdraftPlus set or Hostinger website archive and SQL dump into a new DDEV site. Converts database literals to data-only SQL, checks archives, and leaves restored plugins inactive. Dry runs inspect archives without creating a site.

requiredRuntimes.purpose: Create a local DDEV site and restore a supported WordPress backup into it.
